brief: The canvas presents a translucent medium supporting several whimsical, paper-cut ships. These ships appear heavily aged, showing visible patina, moss, and deep water damage. The edges of the paper are warped, and the deterioration has caused small fragments to detach from the vessels. These fragile, torn pieces drift across the surface alongside the ships, which themselves are surrounded by crystal salt deposits from dissolved wake trails. The overall scene is one of elegant decay and slow, ambient movement.

statement: This sketch depicts a serene yet melancholic scene of aged paper ships drifting in a timeless, translucent sea. Each vessel shows signs of weathering—patina, moss, and water damage—while delicate fragments break away and drift independently. Salt crystals form wake trails behind the ships, adding to the illusion of slow, ambient movement. The visual style uses layered transparency and subtle motion to evoke a sense of elegant decay and quiet passage through time.
